content.short: Presail is an all-in-one platform for Web 3.0 investment groups and projects.
content.description: Presail delivers a comprehensive set of capabilities for Web3 ventures, bringing together fundraising, OTC trading, token vesting, and an investor portal in a single platform. By uniting these essential tools, Presail supports Web3 investment groups and projects across their lifecycle, enabling capital raises, secondary market activity, structured token vesting, and streamlined investor access and communication from one integrated solution.
